Remark
[Integrable scalar datum] 1. ch8:8.32–8.36\group ch08-generalized-solutions The conclusions of this section remain valid with $g\in L^p(\Omega )$, $p=n/(1-\alpha )$, when the $L^p$ norm of $g$ replaces its supremum norm in the estimates.
